driver_archetypes.rationale: Saval et al. 2023, Table 11 (Driver parameter values for Hanoi, column Car, GA-calibrated on Tay Son): max acceleration a = 1.2 m/s2 -> accel, max deceleration b = 4.8 m/s2 -> decel, time headway T = 2.5 s -> tau, safety distance s0 = 1.1 m -> minGap (IDM -> Krauss, literature_transferred). Sec 4: cars always stop at red, so no red-running rule and the jm* attributes stay at the SUMO defaults (never drive at red). One archetype: the paper has one car driver type.

F2 structure (Viktor 2026-10-27, F2-behaviours fix round 1): car violators (custom2, PLAN 0) drawn from the car distribution, the only cars queue_space_seeking may act on. Params copied from car_saval (Saval et al. 2023 Table 11, literature_transferred), so with every p = 0 they drive exactly like car_saval. Share 0.1 is assumed (no source for the share of space-seeking drivers): small, so the B1 car population stays essentially the Saval one; P1/B2 tune it.

Saval et al. 2023, Table 11 (column Motorcycle): a = 1.1 m/s2 -> accel, b = 4.6 m/s2 -> decel, T = 0.8 s -> tau, s0 = 1.9 m -> minGap (IDM -> Krauss, literature_transferred). minGapLat: Sec 4 sizes a motorcycle 'lane' as 0.8 m = 0.7 m width + 0.1 m safe spacing, i.e. ~0.1 m lateral gap; 0.1 m is below the lower bound 0.3 m of the space (ruling R15), so the bound 0.3 m is used (transferred and clipped). One archetype: the paper has one motorcycle driver type. Iteration 1: share 0.75 so that moto_saval + moto_seeker = 1 after raising the seeker share; values unchanged.

F2 structure (Viktor 2026-10-27, F2-behaviours fix round 1): motorcycle violators (custom1, PLAN 0) drawn from the moto distribution, the only riders that may use the custom1-only sidewalk or the right-lane / wrong-lane spaces of queue_space_seeking. Params copied from moto_saval (Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 / Sec 4, literature_transferred), and the same red-running / early-start rules, so with every p = 0 they ride exactly like moto_saval. Share 0.1 is assumed (no source): small, so B1's motorcycle population stays essentially the Saval one; P1/B2 tune it. Iteration 1: share raised 0.1 -> 0.25 so that seeker share x p_sidewalk (0.05) and x p_right_lane (0.02) match the observed per-vehicle choice shares F2/p/sidewalk (0.049 at q20-40) and F2/p/right_lane (0.021), and M10a/M9a ~0.56 per cycle.

Illegal left-turning motorcycles (vTypeDistribution moto_violator). The car-following and lateral values are the motorcycle values of Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 / Sec 4, as for moto_saval: they are the same riders. jmTimegapMinor = 1.0 s is the SUMO default and is assumed (the paper has no illegal left turn and no gap acceptance); it is in the structure because it is the early-leaving lever of the box waiters (ruling R15) that P1/B2 tune.

traci_rules.rationale: Saval et al. 2023, Sec 4 'Description of the model and parameters used': from the Tay Son footage 'the probability of stopping for motorcycles (in the front row) is only 0.5'; 'a motorcycle arriving at a red light will have only a 50% chance to stop'. Transferred as a constant run-the-red probability p0 = p_max = 0.5 for a motorcycle reaching the stop line during red, k = 0 (the paper has no swarm effect). dt = 10 s is assumed and has no effect while k = 0. Iteration 1: p0 = p_max = 0.2 (was 0.5) because the observed M3/share/moto is 0.098 overall, far below a 0.5 stop-line probability applied to every arrival; k stays 0 since M3/var_to_mean = 1.14 (near Poisson, no clustering).

Not in Saval et al. 2023 (assumed): the paper models no early start, so the rule is off (p = 0). It is part of the fixed structure so that P1/B2 can tune the M2 early-start share; t_before_green and v_max are assumed mid-range values without effect while p = 0. Iteration 1: p = 0.15 targets M2/early/moto = 0.130 (rule applies to motorcycles only; M2/early/car 0.011 is negligible); t_before_green = 8 s inside the observed 4-10 s lead window and M2/first_delay = 2.8 s.

Not in Saval et al. 2023 (assumed): the paper has no space seeking (wrong lane, right-turn-lane blocking, sidewalk), so every p = 0 and the green check is off (t_g_s = 0), like early_start p = 0. It is part of the fixed structure (Viktor 2026-10-27) so that P1/B2 can tune behaviours 5-7. q = 30 m, v_creep = 3 m/s and merge_zone_m = 15 m (the Phase 3A setting) are assumed mid-range values without effect while every p = 0. Iteration 1: q = 15 m matches M9c/queue_at_choice 15.7 m and M10b 15.3 m; p_sidewalk 0.2 and p_right_lane 0.08 (times seeker share) give ~0.05 and ~0.02 per vehicle, as F2/p/sidewalk and F2/p/right_lane; p_wrong_lane stays 0 because it is inapplicable on the proxy net (R27) and would be redistributed onto the other options.

description: P1 iteration 1: calibrate red-running, early start and space-seeking rates to observed shares; car-following params kept at Saval values.
